A short course, tools and templates for reproducible empirical work with R,
Quarto and coding agents.

::: {.ledger}

* [Course]{.ledger-label} **[Reproducible research with R, Quarto and coding agents](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd)**

  Two short scrolling tours: how one text file becomes a web page, a PDF,
  slides or a paper, and how an AI agent can do the typing while you review.
  With examples from my 2024/25 seminar at the University of Freiburg and the
  best places to learn more.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [Start the course](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd)
  :::

* [Skills]{.ledger-label} **[A third pair of eyes: AI-assisted consistency review of statistical products](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/third-pair-of-eyes)**

* [Talk]{.ledger-label} **[A Third Pair of Eyes? AI-Assisted Review of Statistical Reports and Code](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/scto-ai-review)**

* [Template]{.ledger-label} **Quarto thesis template**

  For Bachelor's and Master's theses in economics, set up for the University
  of Freiburg and easy to adapt. Text and R code sit in the same files, and one
  command turns them into a formatted PDF, and a web version, with numbered
  figures, tables and equations, cross-references and a bibliography. A short
  worked chapter shows how each piece is written.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [GitHub](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis) | [Example PDF](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis/blob/master/_book/FirstnameLastname_thesis.pdf)
  :::

* [Talk]{.ledger-label} **[Synthetic Control Methods](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/jcod)**

:::
